protocol.model: linear logit on training-standardized features with unpenalized last-column intercept
protocol.initialization: common BCE(lambda=.01), unscaled weights for every fixed beta; NOT an annealing trajectory
protocol.temperature_limit: beta changes effective regularization/initial predictions; no across-beta learning-quality claim
protocol.guard: beta>=16 only; exact beta*maxabs(X)*weighted coupling budget; exact endpoint shortcut in every mode
protocol.timing: single thread, cyclic mode order; cold rule caches per fit; setup, proof, fallback and trace capture included
protocol.primary_cost: common BCE initialization + oracle training + validation threshold/metric selection
protocol.secondary_cost: oracle setup + optimization only; test reporting/replay excluded
protocol.primary_gate: complete matrix, numerical checks, all convergence/fidelity gates, and primary pooled geometric speed ratio>=2 vs faster full-control workflow
limits: ordinary expected-utility training, no collapse-specific invention or predictive-SOTA claim
proof conditional on actual binary64 probabilities and design; no upstream or regularizer FP enclosure
small bounded pilot with one timing per fit, no confidence/significance claim
query error budgets do not imply identical nonconvex optimizer trajectories
case-control real-data seeds share source examples; not independent datasets

scope: post-study formula diagnostic; no optimization reruns or new success gate
limits: ordinary binary64 numerical comparisons, not outward enclosures or global-optimality proofs
